data_objects.name: passenger_records
data_objects.meaning: Passenger records containing identity, travel class, demographic attributes, accompanying-family measures, ticket and cabin references, fare, and embarkation code.

variables.name: PassengerId
variables.meaning: Identifier assigned to a passenger record.

variables.name: Name
variables.meaning: Passenger name, including honorific or title when present.

variables.name: SibSp
variables.meaning: Number of siblings and spouses accompanying the passenger.

variables.name: Parch
variables.meaning: Number of parents and children accompanying the passenger.

variables.name: Ticket
variables.meaning: Ticket reference or code associated with the passenger.

variables.name: Fare
variables.meaning: Passenger fare amount; currency is not stated.

variables.name: Cabin
variables.meaning: Cabin reference associated with the passenger when recorded.

variables.name: Embarked
variables.meaning: Categorical code for the passenger's embarkation location; code meanings are not stated.

structure.description: Each row represents one passenger, with PassengerId serving as the record identifier.
Ticket and Cabin are references that may relate a passenger to shared travel arrangements, but the file supplies no separate ticket or cabin table.

uncertainties: The embarkation codebook and fare currency are not included in the file.
Blank cells indicate unavailable values, but their causes are not distinguished.
annotation_notes: Semantics are limited to the column labels and values visible in train.csv.
